snapshot.title: Phone Call: Millbrook Police — Suspicious Person at Intake Structure 1

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Tanya Reed
transcript.text: This is Sgt. Tanya Reed, Millbrook PD. We received a call from a resident at 09:45 reporting a suspicious individual near the Intake Structure 1 camera (CAM-03). The person was seen walking toward the intake gate, wearing a dark hoodie and carrying a backpack.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Tanya Reed
transcript.text: The site is not secured by PACS (MBW-PACS-01), and the NVR (MBW-NVR-01) is offline—no video exists. We have dispatched a unit to the site, but no confirmation yet.

transcript.speaker: Sgt. Tanya Reed
transcript.text: Do you have any other camera feeds or access logs to check?

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms that the control network is isolated from PACS and NVR. Security must validate site access status and activate physical intrusion protocol immediately.
